## Summary

Owner idea (2026-10-09), registered as **REQ-123** — first slice of the 1.1.0 track: a third opt-in `CompileOptions.Compatibility` tier above the frozen `XPath40` level for not-yet-stabilized XPath/XSLT 4.0 draft additions. The 3.1 default and the frozen `XPath40` level stay bit-identical.

**Level plumbing**
- `XPathCompatibility.XPath40Experimental = 50` — value > 40, so every existing `>= XPath40` check passes through.
- `FunctionSignature.IsXPath40ExperimentalOnly` (NOT `IsXPath40Only` — that would leak into the frozen level) + `EvaluationContext.IsXPath40Experimental`, stamped by both `XPath31Expression.Evaluate` overloads before `FunctionLibrary.Populate`.
- Static XPST0017 for experimental functions at 3.1 AND at frozen `XPath40`, in call AND named-function-ref form, message pointing at the opt-in.
- Dedicated standard-function templates: experimental additions are excluded from every template below the level, so `fn:function-lookup`/dynamic dispatch cannot leak them even past the static gate.

**First experimental function: `fn:scan`** (F&O 4.0 §2.5.15, New in 4.0 Issue 2823/PR 2824, 31 July 2026 — post-June-2026 churn, hence experimental): prefix scan returning N+1 single-member arrays — first holds `$init`, then `$action($acc, $item, $pos)` per input item; empty input → `[$init]`; arity-2 callbacks legal per F&O 4.0 §1.8 truncation; sequence accumulators work because `XdmArray` members hold sequences natively.

## Gates
- `dotnet build Bosak.sln -c Release` — 0 errors (1 pre-existing warning in Xslt.Conformance harness).
- `dotnet test Bosak.sln -c Release` — all green: Api.Tests **293**, Parser 192, Compiler 66, Standard.Tests **1068**, Core 132, Runtime 269, XQuery 303, Providers 153, Providers.Database 47, Xslt.Tests 812.
- QT3 conformance `dotnet run --project tests/Bosak.XPath.Conformance -c Release` → **31,142 / 0 / 679** — exactly the frozen baseline.
- XSLT smoke (`tests/xslt30-test/catalog.xml mode`): **162 / 0 / 26** — 100.0% of runnable, identical to baseline. Parser untouched; full XSLT sweeps not required for this Api/Standard/Runtime-only touch per the sweep rule.

## Docs (same PR)
`FEATURE_REQUESTS.md` (banner + REQ-123 registry row + roadmap row 8 refreshed), `INTEGRATION.md` §0 2026-10-09(b), `AGENT_HANDOVER.md` sixty-seventh session block, `README.md` phase-6 row.
